completedGoals.title: Visible Abs
completedGoals.recap: This journey began with a clear finish line: reveal visible abdominal definition without sacrificing the muscle built before the cut. Across eight deliberate weeks, body fat moved into the target range, the waist and midsection became substantially leaner, and training continued to protect the shape underneath. The final DEXA and relaxed photos told the same story—the goal had reached its intended conclusion.

highlights.title: The measured starting point
highlights.body: The first DEXA established the body-composition baseline for the journey.

highlights.title: Definition became measurable
highlights.body: Body-composition and visual evidence showed clear movement toward the finish line.

highlights.title: The finish line aligned
highlights.body: The final DEXA and relaxed photo confirmed visible abdominal definition at rest.

highlights.title: Lean mass largely preserved
highlights.body: Measured lean mass remained within the journey’s preservation tolerance.

finalComposition.narrative: This scan closed the journey because the numerical target and final visual confirmation converged: fat mass fell meaningfully, abdominal definition was visible at rest, and measured lean mass remained within the journey’s preservation tolerance.

achievedBy: Body fat moved from the starting baseline into the target range.
Lean mass was largely preserved through the cut.
Nutrition consistency held through the finish.
Training performance remained strong enough to protect muscularity.

unlocked.title: Build Lean Mass

supportingObjectives.title: Maintain Strength Baseline
supportingObjectives.narrative: Working sets across major lifts have held within 5% of their maintenance baseline through the current lean mass phase, confirming training load is being preserved rather than traded away for the lean-mass build.

supportingObjectives.title: Preserve Lean Mass
supportingObjectives.detail: Lean mass stable across recent DEXA scans
supportingObjectives.narrative: Lean mass has held or increased across every DEXA scan recorded during the current Goal, confirming the lean-mass build is proceeding without an offsetting loss elsewhere.
